steps.message: The address is issued on the read address (AR) channel.
The data and response is returned on the read data (R) channel. The number of data beats required is
The address is issued on the AR channel.
A single transfer on the R channel returns the response. No data is returned for a Clean transaction.
Completion of a Clean transaction is signaled by the master asserting RACK.
The address is issued on the AR channel.
A single transfer on the R channel returns the response. No data is returned for a Make transaction.
Completion of a Make transaction is signaled by the master asserting RACK.
The address is issued on the AW channel.
The data is transferred on the W channel.
The response is returned on the B channel.
Completion of a Write transaction is signaled by the master asserting WACK.
The transaction is issued on the AW channel.
The response is returned on the B channel. No data is transferred for a Write Barrier transaction.
Completion of a Write Barrier transaction is signaled by the master asserting WACK.
The transaction is issued on the AR channel.
A single transfer on the R channel returns the response. No data is returned for a DVM transaction.
Completion of a DVM transaction is signaled by the master asserting RACK.
